notes: Matched-budget reset-timing comparison. Triggered arm exhausted all K=8 reset events in tasks 5-68 across ALL seeds (highly consistent). Budget was consumed in the early phase; no resets in tasks 69-280. This indicates the erank trigger fires immediately after each refractory gap throughout the first ~70 tasks. To isolate timing value, compare mean_ss_acc to fixed/random arms which spread resets more evenly across 280 tasks. Run time: ~580s on H100.
